name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 4 visits over 12 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 12 hours starting 2025-07-02, at wavelengths from 0.98 to 4.72 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
